candidates.reason: Rules-valid and on-theme, but the registered comparison never cast either candidate and therefore did not demonstrate a material upgrade over Mind's Desire; retain baseline rather than infer superiority.
Broader permanent targeting does not outweigh sorcery-speed temporary bounce versus Bituminous Blast's instant-speed creature interaction while preserving printed cascade.
Real exile-cast recursion synergy, but replacing Thermo-Alchemist removes a cheap repeatable all-opponent threshold enabler without evidence that the pinger package is redundant.
Powerful refill/finisher but MV 11 and creature-death discount do not solve Abaddon's threshold/castability needs; no defensible cut was identified.

red_team_findings.claim: Fast mana, tutors, free interaction and Breach could overwhelm commander identity.
red_team_findings.resolution: Blueprint and final list retain a large threshold/cascade/exile engine; Breach is a secondary compact route rather than the sole plan.

red_team_findings.claim: Five-mana commander plus 34 lands could be inconsistent.
red_team_findings.resolution: Baseline density analysis documents 34 lands, 19 ramp tags and 12 explicit early accelerators; no predeclared comparison demonstrates a superior land/ramp configuration.

red_team_findings.claim: Mind's Desire may be retained merely because the Aurora Phoenix test was uninformative.
red_team_findings.resolution: Inconclusive evidence cannot justify mutation. Mind's Desire retains a distinct high-ceiling storm role; candidate remains rejected for lack of demonstrated material gain, not because the test proved baseline superiority.

red_team_findings.claim: Breach/LED/Brain Freeze may be overstated as an unconditional infinite.
red_team_findings.resolution: Worked audit proves only a specified uninterrupted sequence with explicit fuel, mana, storm and library accounting; documentation explicitly forbids unconditional-infinite claims.

red_team_findings.claim: The deck could function as generic Grixis storm without Abaddon.
red_team_findings.resolution: The primary blueprint centers same-turn opponent life loss converting hand-cast spells into cascade and then leveraging exile-cast payoffs; removing Abaddon materially removes the conversion engine even though the secondary Breach route survives.

commander_necessity.thesis: Abaddon converts same-turn opponent life loss into additional cascade instances on qualifying spells cast from hand, making threshold sequencing the primary engine and enabling the deck's cascade/exile payoff network.

evidence_dimensions.name: commander_identity
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Blueprint, packages and red-team counterfactual show the primary engine depends materially on Abaddon.

evidence_dimensions.name: engine
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Threshold, cascade and exile-value packages are explicitly documented and rules-reviewed.

evidence_dimensions.name: mana
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Exact density analysis documents 34 lands and acceleration probabilities; no superior configuration is demonstrated.

evidence_dimensions.name: interaction
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Card-level interaction triage and current Oracle review cover the exact frozen list.

evidence_dimensions.name: resilience
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Protection and secondary combo route are present, but no exhaustive multiplayer resilience benchmark is claimed.

evidence_dimensions.name: conversion
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Cascade/exile engines, damage amplification and Breach route provide documented conversion paths.

evidence_dimensions.name: combo_integrity
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Breach/LED/Brain Freeze plus Wheel has a bounded worked sequence with explicit starting inventory and accounting.

evidence_dimensions.name: card_quality
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Sixty candidate decisions found no demonstrated material upgrade and documented concrete tradeoffs.

evidence_dimensions.name: candidate_exhaustion
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Sixty recorded candidates were closed for the current build; no high-impact unresolved HOLD remains.

evidence_dimensions.name: testing
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Forge comparison was inconclusive and is not used as superiority evidence; analytical evidence is sufficient to retain the unchanged baseline absent a demonstrated swap.

evidence_dimensions.name: rules_confidence
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Current Oracle metadata and bounded material interaction review passed; combo claims are constrained to proven conditions.

evidence_dimensions.name: source_freshness
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Current Scryfall bulk refresh and official Commander ban-list checkpoint passed on 2026-10-13.
